scope: Direct-exit focused Linux gate for the corrected entity narrow-phase output contract (review finding ENV-ENTITY-CALLER-BUFFER-1 of c510c55c7). Every step is a direct child whose exit was read on the next line, output went to one combined log, excerpts were taken after the status was recorded. Not a native, Windows or retail run.
environment: WSL daemon EECH-D2-Build, image sha256:4a5618cbc1e13e96caa4cb1ff0076c4c24dc883876d0bdec1398024f3a2d6c51, cache volume eech-linux-d3-collision-driver-5416adb3b-20261029 (no container existed before; runner refuses if one does), --network none

code_inputs.scope: aphavoc eech-campaign/crates eech-campaign/Cargo.toml eech-campaign/Cargo.lock eech-campaign/tools; tracked and untracked-not-ignored files, taken on the Windows checkout where Git resolves, new inputs included
code_inputs.meaning: The filtered column is the Git blob id of each working file as Git's clean filter would store it; the raw column is the SHA-256 of the working file's raw bytes. They are different identities: for three pre-existing CRLF files (aphavoc/laa.c, aphavoc/source/entity/special/effect/explosn/xp_types.h, aphavoc/source/entity/special/effect/smokelst/sl_types.h) the filtered id is the LF-normalised form (core.autocrlf=input) and is NOT their committed blob, while their raw working bytes equal their committed bytes (CR counts 64, 66, 119 in both; filter-qualification.txt). The raw column is the byte identity. No accepted C file was normalised or rewritten.

red_controls_not_counted_as_green.note: The isolated C control was run against three deliberately mutated adapters (the mutation was applied to mb_hostentity.h on the working tree and reverted; the header's blob id was verified equal to its pre-mutation id afterwards). Each must fail, and each did.
mutants: reads the caller's point buffer before the exchange (SIGSEGV on the unreadable page)
writes the normal before the reply is checked (SIGSEGV on the unwritable page)
commits the assigned normal before checking the reply (FAIL lines: refused answers changed the caller's normal)
